Publicit is a self-service advertising platform focused on Connected TV (CTV). Advertisers launch CTV campaigns in minutes and extend them to DOOH, OOH, in-app and other channels from a single dashboard, without agencies or long setup cycles.

  

### Which advertising channels can I reach?

You can run campaigns on out-of-home billboards, digital screens, metro and transit, mobile apps, CTV, press, and more. Publicit connects advertising inventory across Europe so you plan and buy from one place.

results.content: Publicit is a Barcelona-based advertising technology company developing an infrastructure designed to simplify access to omnichannel programmatic advertising for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). The company was founded by Gabriel García Asensio, a former CERN engineer specializing in low-latency neural network inference; Andrés Buendía, who has a background in AdTech product and business at Seedtag and Nacional.cat; and Jordi Orteu, whose experience includes go-to-market strategy and European SMB business development at Deel. The founding team aims to address a structural inefficiency in the advertising industry, where access to premium ad inventory beyond major platforms like Google and Meta often requires manual negotiations and large budgets, effectively excluding most smaller [...] traditional digital placements, from a single interface. This model is designed to democratize access to diverse advertising inventory, allowing companies of any size to utilize the same channels and programmatic tools that were previously accessible only to large brands and agencies. By providing direct, programmatic access to a global advertising marketplace, Publicit aims to empower the 'long tail' of advertisers and break down the barriers created by complex, contract-based ad buying processes. Keywords: programmatic advertising, self-service ad platform, omnichannel advertising, adtech infrastructure, CTV advertising, DOOH advertising, digital audio ads, SMB advertising solutions, media buying platform, Gabriel García Asensio, Andrés Buendía, Jordi Orteu, BStartup Banco Sabadell, [...] and large budgets, effectively excluding most smaller companies. In May 2026, Publicit announced it had secured €700,000 in a pre-seed funding round. The round was co-led by BStartup Banco Sabadell and Successful Fund, with participation from Aticco Labs and several business angels from the Spanish technology and media sectors. The company intends to use the capital to advance the development of its advertising infrastructure, enhance its AI capabilities, and broaden access to its tools for smaller businesses. The core of Publicit's offering is a self-service platform that enables advertisers to launch and manage campaigns across a wide range of channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH), digital audio, and traditional digital placements, from a single interface.

results.content:
Publicit is building the infrastructure that removes the intermediary. Publishers list their own inventory and set their own prices. Advertisers search that inventory, see the real price of each space, and book it themselves. The company describes what it is building as advertising infrastructure designed to improve access to digital and omnichannel advertising for small and medium-sized businesses.

The two sides are deliberately symmetrical. A publisher is not passive inventory: they review each campaign requested for their space and decide whether it runs. An advertiser is not a line in someone else's media plan: they pick every placement by hand.

## The founders

Three co-founders, in Barcelona, in January 2025.

 The three Publicit co-founders on a rooftop in Barcelona [...] ## What Publicit operates

 The infrastructure and dashboard at dashboard.publicit.com, where advertisers build campaigns and publishers list spaces.
 Publicit Ad-Exchange, programmatic RTB infrastructure for CTV, DOOH, OOH and in-app inventory, normalized into OpenRTB-compatible formats. Currently in early access.
 Publicit MCP, a native Model Context Protocol server, so campaigns can be managed in plain language from an AI assistant such as Claude. One of the first among advertising platforms.
 Escrowed payments through Stripe: an advertiser's payment is held until the publisher evidences delivery, and the publisher receives the full agreed price for their space.

How the infrastructure works step by step is on the platform page, and the publisher side on Publicit for publishers. [...] # Publicit, the self-service advertising platform built in Barcelona
